intro: Innkeeper Gryshka is an orc host who manages the Broken Tusk inn in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. Serving as the primary hospitality contact for travelers arriving through the city gates, she provides hearthstone bindings, food, and drink to visiting Horde adventurers. She maintains close ties with hunters and scouts across Durotar and the Barrens to keep her tavern stocked with choice cuts of meat.

sections.t: Hearth of the Valley of Strength
p: Standing behind the counter of the Broken Tusk, Gryshka manages one of the most heavily trafficked inns in the Horde. Located just beyond the main gates of Orgrimmar in the Valley of Strength, her establishment serves as the first point of rest for warriors, messengers, and newly arrived champions seeking shelter under Thrall's banner.

Running a bustling tavern in an arid canyon requires steady supply lines. Gryshka maintains a well-known affinity for fresh meat, relying on trusted hunters across the Horde territories to supply her kitchen. Companions such as Zargh in the Crossroads and Grimtak in Durotar routinely ship their finest game cuts back to the Broken Tusk to satisfy her demanding culinary standards.
